format: Perl (assembly code for md5 block implementation)
description: This file contains Perl code that generates x86 assembly routines for MD5 hash computation, specifically the md5_block function and related helper functions for different rounds of the MD5 algorithm.

methods.name: Np
methods.description: Returns a value based on the current register mapping for use in MD5 rounds.

methods.description: Performs the first round operation of MD5 on x86 assembly.

methods.description: Performs the second round operation of MD5 on x86 assembly.

methods.name: R2
methods.description: Performs the third round operation of MD5 on x86 assembly, with conditional logic based on the round number.

methods.name: R3
methods.description: Performs the fourth round operation of MD5 on x86 assembly.

methods.description: Main function generating the MD5 block processing assembly code, implementing the MD5 algorithm rounds.
